description: Combat rules (battle-sim.md §11). No hit points: every blow that gets through leaves a wound. Chances are permille (‰). A blow gets through with hitChance[weapon][attacker's experience] minus the defender's shield, body armour, head cover, experience and warrior type, plus position (flank, rear; a shield wall in front protects more), minus the attacker's own wound penalty, kept within hitLimits. position.frontArc / rearArc: from the defender's facing to the attacker, within frontArc degrees is his front, up to rearArc his flank, beyond his rear (decided 2026-11-23). strikeArc: a man strikes only an enemy within this many degrees of his facing; engaged men turn toward their enemy (decided 2026-11-23). shieldFromFlank / shieldFromRear: the share (‰) of the shield's protection that still counts from the flank / rear. reach: gap between bodies a weapon fights across (m); windup and recovery: seconds before and after the blow (whole 0.05 s ticks). wounds: how a blow that gets through lands (light + heavy + down = 1000). experience.morale: the morale a man of that level starts with (morale.json, decided 2026-11-23). Fighters (fighters.json) take defaultKit for anything they don't name. Every number is a proposal of 2026-11-22, tuned on the M3 bench.
